Short title extent and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1999
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE SARHAD DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1999
ACT VIII OF 1999
An
Act to amend the North-West Frontier Province Sarhad Development Authority Act,
1972
[Gazette of N.-W. F.
P. Extraordinary,. 13th October, 1999]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis:I/99/24272,
dated 13-10-1999.--The North- West Frontier Province Sarhad Development
Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1999; having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of North-West Frontier. Province on the 22nd September, 1999 and assented to by
the Governor of the -North-West Frontier Province on 7th October, 1999, is
hereby published as- an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West
Frontier Province.
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.-- (1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Sarhad Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of Section 22A in N.W.F.P. Act XI of 1973

ACT VIII OF 1999
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE SARHAD DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1999
ACT VIII OF 1999
An
Act to amend the North-West Frontier Province Sarhad Development Authority Act,
1972
[Gazette of N.-W. F.
P. Extraordinary,. 13th October, 1999]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis:I/99/24272,
dated 13-10-1999.--The North- West Frontier Province Sarhad Development
Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1999; having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of North-West Frontier. Province on the 22nd September, 1999 and assented to by
the Governor of the -North-West Frontier Province on 7th October, 1999, is
hereby published as- an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West
Frontier Province.
2. Insertion of Section 22A in
N.W.F.P. Act. XI of 1973.-- In the North-West Frontier Province Sarhad
Development Authority Act, 1972
(N.W.F.P. Act XI of 1973), after section 22, the following new section
22A shall be inserted, namely:
"22A. Recovery of Authority
dues.
(1) The Authority may declare
that any dues or class of dues recoverable by it from a defaulter shall be
recoverable as arrears of land revenue.
(2) On a declaration under
sub-section (1), any such dues shall be recovered by the Collector in the
mariner laid d own in the Revenue Recoveries Act, 1890 (Act No. 1, of
1890)."
